meta.title: Ceramic Coating in Boulder City, NV | BC Glass & Tint
meta.description: Ceramic coating bonded to your paint by hand, so water and dirt slide off instead of baking on in the desert sun. Boulder City shop, family owned since 1994.

v3.lede: A coating bonded to your paint by hand, so water and dirt slide off instead of baking on in the desert sun.

prices.lede: The vehicle and how much correction the paint needs first set the price.

items.title: Paint, glass and trim.
items.text: We use DuraSlic DS 1500 Xtreme and treat the paint, glass and plastic trim, so the whole exterior is covered.

items.title: Two to four days.
items.text: The paint is decontaminated and corrected before anything is bonded to it, and we keep the car a further 24 hours while the coating cures.

items.title: Windshield ceramic coating
items.text: Rain and bugs come off easier.

items.title: Clear bra
items.text: Paint protection film for the front end.

items.question: How long will my car be at the shop?
items.answer: Usually two to four days, depending on the car. The paint has to be decontaminated and corrected before anything is bonded to it, and darker paint shows every swirl, so it takes more correction work. After the coating goes on we keep the vehicle a further 24 hours while it cures.

items.question: What do I need to avoid after a ceramic coating?
items.answer: Keep it dry while it finishes curing. For the first 24 hours to three days, depending on conditions, do not wash the vehicle, do not park it where sprinklers can reach it, and try to keep it out of the rain. We will tell you the exact window for your car when you pick it up.
